text: {"label": "Self-Control Choice and Training","definition": "Basic and applied research on choosing larger delayed over smaller immediate outcomes, including delay fading, time-based interventions, commitment procedures, aversive events, and self-control training in humans and rats.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Centres on smaller-sooner versus larger-later choice and teaching self-control, rather than general choice and conditioned reinforcement, operant avoidance of aversive events, or self-injurious behavior."}
